title: Make SCHC Sender-Abort terminal after the fourth negative ACK
description: Security review finding in python/src/lichen/schc/fragment.py handle_ack_bytes: when the negative-ACK retry limit is reached, the sender returns a Sender-Abort fragment but does not transition status to aborted. Repeated attacker-controlled negative ACKs can consequently trigger unlimited Sender-Abort transmissions and duty-cycle/resource exhaustion, while a later C=1 ACK can reverse the supposed terminal outcome and mark the transfer successful.
acceptance_criteria: The retry-limit branch atomically transitions the sender to a terminal aborted state before returning exactly one Sender-Abort. Every later ACK and timeout is ignored and cannot emit another fragment or change the terminal result. Tests exercise the fourth negative ACK, repeated later negative ACKs, a later complete ACK, and timeout after abort, proving one abort emission and no terminal-state reversal. Run three independent correctness, security, and robustness code-review passes and file every resulting finding before closure.
